notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.2.8
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[b]Added: [/b]Introduced more bot names
[b]Changes:[/b] The game will now enter offline mode if a connection with Steam could not be made
[b]Changes:[/b] Changing the server setting "Fill Empty Spots With Bots" to true from false, will now immediately make BOTS join
[b]Changes:[/b] The shocked random effect will now hinder the player's speed when getting shocked
[b]Changes:[/b] The shocked random effect trail is now less distracting
[b]Changes:[/b] Changed the time before the bomb explodes in the bomb gamemode from 25 sec to 20 sec
[b]Changes:[/b] In the bomb and elimination gamemode, the tagger will now move faster than the runners

[h1]Fixes: [/h1]
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where a player would not be kicked if their save file was invalid
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where a player would not always be disconnected from a lobby
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where getting kicked because of a invalid save game, would display the wrong kicked message
[b]Bug Fix: [/b]Resolved an issue where the game would crash on the main menu if the connection to Steam was lost
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where friends could not join a friend that was in a server with "Show Server in Server List" set to false
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where BOTS would walk at really high speeds

Thank you for playing!
